Mattias "'''Preacher'''" Konradsson (1977) is a former Swedish Quakeworld mapper mainly remembered for designing [[aerowalk]].

==Achievements==
* Creator of [[aerowalk]], [[badwalk]], [[basewalk]] among other maps.
